tonight.headline: Tuten is still in the FLEX and locks at 19:15
body: Bad news first. Bhayshul Tuten is still in the FLEX after missing all three practices, and every one of the 27 Coen-era players who did that sat (SI, 5 Nov). No insider ruling by 15:00Z. He locks when Jacksonville kick off at Baltimore at 19:15. Garrett Wilson, in a WR slot, is still in the concussion protocol. Rice and Pickens, the receivers behind him, were both limited Wednesday.
As set Bloodsports project 130.6 against Jackrabbits' 124.0; the projection lineup is 133.5. Make the three swaps — Gordon for Tuten first, today.

case.label: Their lineup
case.body: Jackrabbits start Derrick Henry and Zay Flowers behind rookie Joe Fagnano tonight — against your Jaguars D/ST, 9.5-point road favourites, total 39.5 (DraftKings via CBS 5 Nov). Ashton Jeanty sits in their FLEX after two carries in Week 8; Kubiak calls the split 'a moving target' (Yahoo 4 Nov).

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Bloodsports set the projection lineup and still lose by more than 10 — then it was the roster, not the lineup.

doFirst.title: Start Gordon in the FLEX, bench Tuten — today
doFirst.subtitle: Fourth run asking. A coin flip the projection takes, and Tuten has not practised all week.

case.label: The flip
case.body: Gordon 16.5, Tuten 15.4: inside two points. Take the projection; no thesis.

case.label: The news
case.body: Tuten DNP Monday to Wednesday (Jaguars.com 4 Nov); all 27 Coen-era players who missed every practice also missed the game (SI 5 Nov 10:45Z). Gordon is off Miami's report with both backups on it — Wright DNP, Allen limited (Yahoo 4 Nov).

case.label: Since 07:00
case.body: No ruling from any insider by ~15:00Z (Athlon 14:08Z; CBS 5 Nov). Jacksonville -9.5, total down from 42.5 to 39.5 (DraftKings via CBS) — a lower-scoring game for whoever plays.

case.label: The clock
case.body: Once Jacksonville kick off at 19:15 Tuten cannot be moved. If he is inactive and still in the FLEX, the slot scores zero.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Tuten plays and outscores Gordon in Week 9 (archive).

doFirst.title: Start Rice, bench Garrett Wilson
doFirst.subtitle: 13.9 to 12.8 — a coin flip; take the projection. Wilson is in the concussion protocol.

case.label: The flip
case.body: Rice 13.9, Wilson 12.8: inside two points.

case.label: The facts
case.body: Wilson DNP Wednesday, concussion protocol, day-to-day (Jets report, ESPN 4 Nov). Rice limited, called planned maintenance (Yahoo 4 Nov 22:03Z).

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Wilson outscores Rice in Week 9 (archive).

doFirst.title: Start Likely at TE, bench Loveland
doFirst.subtitle: 12.8 to 12.1 — a coin flip; take the projection.

case.label: The flip
case.body: Likely 12.8, Loveland 12.1: inside one point.

case.label: The contested read
case.body: Loveland has the highest TE target share over three weeks, 28.9% (Sharp 4 Nov), and Tampa Bay are 23rd on TEs while Philadelphia are 3rd (StatChasers). That is the case for Loveland, and it is the volume-and-matchup case the backtest says the projection already carries. Take the number.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Loveland outscores Likely in Week 9 (archive).

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only — check Sun 8 Nov 10:30 CDMX
doFirst.title: If Rice is inactive Sunday, start Pickens
doFirst.subtitle: Limited Wednesday as maintenance; Wilson, the other option, is in the protocol.

case.label: The injury
case.body: Hamstring/knee; limited Wednesday, planned maintenance (Yahoo 4 Nov). Back in Week 8 with 8 targets (archive).

case.label: The fallback
case.body: Pickens 13.1, limited Wednesday with the hamstring only (CBS 4 Nov). Ferguson's ankle sprain could free Dallas targets. Wilson only if cleared and Pickens is also out.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Rice is active and Pickens would have outscored him (archive) — the contingency only fires on an inactive.

whatWentWrong.title: Three coin flips are still set the wrong way
whatWentWrong.lead: 2.9 projected points unset after two runs asked, one on a player who has not practised and locks tonight.

case.label: What happened
case.body: No lineup moves by Bloodsports since Wednesday morning (activity log); Tuten, Wilson and Loveland still start.

case.label: What changed since
case.body: SI's 27-for-27 count makes Tuten's absence the likely outcome, not a toss-up; Wilson is still in the protocol.

case.label: The fix
case.body: The three lineup cards above, Tuten's before 19:15.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The benched three outscore the started three in Week 9 (archive).

lineupCheck.verdict: The lineup as set is 2.9 below the projection lineup across three coin flips — Gordon over Tuten (before 19:15 tonight), Rice over Wilson, Likely over Loveland; take the projection on all three.

worthALook.name: Mike Washington Jr.
worthALook.lead: A free agent here — no priority — but Kubiak will not name a lead back.

case.label: The player
case.body: 60% of snaps, 25 carries for 83, no targets in Week 8; Jeanty a season-low 40% (CBS 3 Nov). Kubiak: the backfield is 'always a moving target', snaps to whoever plays best (Yahoo 4 Nov). Graziano: Las Vegas are content to tilt carries to Washington unless Jeanty responds (Bleacher Report 4 Nov).

case.label: Why not
case.body: Bloodsports carry five backs, and Marks — the obvious drop — has Houston's backfield with Montgomery out (DraftSharks 4 Nov).

case.label: When to act
case.body: A second week as the lead at San Francisco, and Montgomery back in Houston — then a free-agent add for Marks.
